test_title: PYST 12: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter - series.

Z X C _ B Z _ _ V B _ X E V _ Z _ _ V B

options.text: U Y E Z B X F
U X D Z B X F
V Y E Z B X G
V X D Z B X F

solution:
**Given:**

Z X C _ B Z _ _ V B _ X E V _ Z _ _ V B

Checking all the given options:

**1. **U Y E Z B X F

Z X C U B / Z Y E V B / Z X E V B / Z X F V B

**2.** U X D Z B X F

Z X C U B / Z X D V B / Z X E V B / Z X F V B

**3.** V Y E Z B X G

Z X C V B / Z Y E V B / Z X E V B / Z X G V B

**4. V X D Z B X F**

Z X **C** V B / Z X **D** V B / Z X **E **V B / Z X **F** V B [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e1509f541d662c3ed47d7c7e568e6a25c57fb40f3fa03f076d643e5403554b0.png] 

 

Here, the series is completed.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
